summary.text: Jennifer Kincart Jonsson represents District 49 in the Florida House of Representatives, to which Kincart Jonsson was elected in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Kincart Jonsson is an executive who lives in Lakeland and was born in Jacksonville.
Kincart Jonsson holds a bachelor's degree in health science and a master of public health from the University of Florida.
